root_cause.text: In __ip_vs_get_out_rt(), the error path calls dst_link_failure(skb) without ensuring skb->dev is set, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when fib_compute_spec_dst() later accesses skb->dev.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "The IPv4 code path in __ip_vs_get_out_rt() calls dst_link_failure() without ensuring skb->dev is set, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in fib_compute_spec_dst()". The patch adds `if (!skb->dev) skb->dev = skb_dst(skb)->dev;` before `dst_link_failure(skb);` to fix this.
